topic: Data API access and system monitoring issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: data reporting structure and technical infrastructure stability. Regarding data, [me] provided a cURL example for accessing the JCD BR report using the v4 API endpoint, specifying date ranges and duration granularities. It was noted that the corporate system currently uses the /jcd endpoint, which contains legacy data.

On the technical side, there were multiple issues reported with internal systems: mon.allunite.local was inaccessible, followed by reports of instability concerning ch04 and clickhouse02 (ch02). The participants monitored the status of these services via SSH and Grafana links, noting high iowait on ch02 at one point, but eventually confirming that the core systems were operational, though the network infrastructure ('сетка') was unstable.
decisions: The v4 API endpoint structure for JCD BR reporting was confirmed/shared.
action_items: Monitor system stability and performance of internal data services (ch02, ch04).
